description: The provided image is a 3D bar chart illustrating the accuracy of different models across various reasoning types. The horizontal plane is divided into two axes: the x-axis represents the reasoning type, with categories labeled "Inductive," "Deductive," and "Mix," while the y-axis represents the model, with labels "BARD" and "Davinci-003." Each model is represented by a group of bars corresponding to the three reasoning types. The bars are color-coded using a gradient from blue (lower accuracy) to yellow (higher accuracy), indicating the accuracy value for each model and reasoning type combination. The chart shows that for both models, accuracy generally increases from "Inductive" to "Deductive" to "Mix." The tallest bar, representing the highest accuracy, is for the "Davinci-003" model on the "Mix" reasoning type, reaching a value of approximately 0.8. The shortest bar, representing the lowest accuracy, is for the "BARD" model on the "Inductive" reasoning type, with a value of approximately 0.3. The "Davinci-003" model consistently shows higher accuracy than the "BARD" model across all three reasoning types.
